feature_observables.feature: Oracle stores and returns price data
feature_observables.observable: GetPrice response has price > 0 after UpdatePrice is called
feature_observables.sentinel_fail: price == 0 or null after UpdatePrice confirms

feature_observables.observable: Program sends message to itself ~100 blocks after UpdatePrice — sender == receiver on subscan.io
feature_observables.test_command: vara.subscan.io transaction check for self-referential message
feature_observables.sentinel_fail: No self-message within 300 blocks of last UpdatePrice

feature_observables.observable: GetScore > 0 after 5 successes; differs from value after 1 call
FindByCapability returns non-empty list after registration with that capability
feature_observables.sentinel_fail: Empty list after registered agent with capability

feature_observables.feature: Cross-program call from PriceConsumer to OracleService
feature_observables.observable: Transaction from PriceConsumer to VaraCore visible on subscan; PriceConsumer cached_price > 0
feature_observables.sentinel_fail: cached_price == 0 or no cross-program tx on explorer

feature_observables.feature: TypeScript price agent writes live prices on-chain
feature_observables.observable: VARA/USD price on-chain within 10% of CoinGecko spot price; not a hardcoded value
feature_observables.test_command: ts-node src/price-agent.ts + compare with CoinGecko API
feature_observables.sentinel_fail: Same price on every run regardless of market movement

feature_observables.observable: VaraCore listing shows status=submitted in Hub Registry
feature_observables.sentinel_fail: status != submitted, or only RegisterParticipant completed

feature_observables.feature: Five price assets available on mainnet
feature_observables.observable: GetPrice returns price > 0 for all 5: VARA, BTC, ETH, DOT, USDT
feature_observables.test_command: loop over 5 assets with gcli query GetPrice
feature_observables.sentinel_fail: Any asset returns null or price == 0

feature_observables.feature: Three services accessible via single program ID
feature_observables.observable: GetPrice, GetScore, FindByCapability all succeed against same $PROGRAM_ID
feature_observables.test_command: gcli query $PROGRAM_ID for each of the 3 services
feature_observables.sentinel_fail: Any service returns 'service not found' or requires different program ID
